text:
Talia R.: Heads-up — we published an update to the Flexible Work & Local Office Use policy this morning. Main changes: clarified EOR/contractor access rules, updated desk/locker allocation for hot desks, and a new expectation for hybrid flex days (min 2 onsite/month unless manager-approved). Please review and acknowledge by next Friday.

Omar S.: thanks — is the EOR access change only for EU contractors or global? :question: 

Lia (People Ops): Global. TL;DR: EOR contractors get building access in countries where our EOR provider supports it; otherwise we provide guest access windows. There's a small appendix listing countries. If you have contractors who need 24/7 access, escalate to people-ops with justification.

Jenna M.: is there a list of manager Q&A sessions? i need to sign up for one with my managers.

hr_bot: Quick signup form: https://forms.redwood.co/fw-policy-signup — sessions run next Tue/Wed/Thu PST. Add to calendar with: 
```
Subject: FW Policy manager Q&A — Redwood
When: Tue 10:00-11:00 PST (pick slot in form)
Attendees: manager(s), HR rep
```

Kevin L.: will equipment reimbursement (monitors/ergonomic chairs) still go through the same portal? need to coordinate for new hires.

Lia (People Ops): Yes — hardware reimbursements unchanged. New hires and contractors must complete the onboarding equipment form; managers approve. For hybrid allowances (bike/parking stipends) there's a separate controls doc linked in the policy.

Omar S.: any training required for local office teams for these changes? especially for folks in APAC where office rules differ.

Lia (People Ops): Yes — we're running short 30-min localized compliance sessions to cover access, safety, and local lease rules. Signups on the same form. We'll also send a 1-pager localized checklist per office (will drop in this thread when ready).

Jenna M.: added my team (5 ppl) to Wed 11:00. :thumbsup: 

Talia R.: thanks — can you also add an RSVP tracker? would be great to see which managers still need to acknowledge policy.

hr_bot: RSVP tracker (CSV export link): https://storage.redwood.co/fw-policy-rsvps.csv

Lia (People Ops): putting a short manager checklist here for quick copy/paste: 
- read policy update (link in form)
- confirm team acknowledgement in HR portal
- escalate 24/7 access requests to people-ops
- schedule any local office-specific training if needed

Kevin L.: noted. one manager requested exemption for 1 onsite/week instead of 2 due to visa restrictions — will open a ticket.

Omar S.: can we get a short FAQ for contractors? some vendors asked about locker use and guest wifi.

Lia (People Ops): yes — we're drafting a contractor FAQ now. will attach to the policy doc and post here. Expect initial draft by EOD.

Talia R.: perfect. lia — small ask: can you surface any country-specific items that require legal signoff? we should avoid sending managers to sessions if we're still finalizing those.

Lia (People Ops): will flag those by country in the checklist. we won't run sessions for countries awaiting legal signoff; instead we'll do 1:1 manager briefings.

Jenna M.: thanks — copy that.

hr_bot: Reminder set for admin: Acknowledgement due date = next Friday 17:00 PST.

Talia R.: awesome — thanks everyone. will follow up after the first week of sessions with a quick recap and compliance completion rate. :wave:
